coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 使用顶点权重或少量骨骼形变；根部权重为0，叶尖为1。不可将整株当刚体连花箱一起摇。

states.name: 无风
states.visual_description: Leaves and flowers upright at neutral pose.

states.name: 向左摆
states.visual_description: Only upper foliage and flower stems sway gently to IMAGE LEFT; roots stay anchored in same planter. No pot motion.

states.name: 向右摆
states.visual_description: Same exact leaf clusters and flowers sway to IMAGE RIGHT with opposite gentle bend, no new leaves or flowers.

states.name: 回弹
states.visual_description: Foliage returning near center with slight opposite lag in flexible flower stems. Pot and roots perfectly stationary.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。

wind_clip.note: 花箱/花盆/根固定；主摆动与叶尖余振分层。
